description: A neutral starting point for any tracker that can show a name, a status and a stage per row (a board, a spreadsheet, an issue list). Copy it, rename it and adjust the field names and status values to match the tracker.
fetch: With the tracker's connector, list every row of the board, sheet or project at meta.tracker.target (follow pagination). Write a JSON list to a file with one object per row, keyed by this adapter's field names; flatten every property to a plain string (a select or status as its option name, a date as ISO text, empty as an empty string), and save the rows as the tracker holds them: never build the list from the plan.
relational_fetch: With the connector, query every row of each database the plan's meta.tracker.target names (one for epics, stories, tasks and releases, or one shared database; all pages). Save ONE JSON list; add "kind": "epic" | "story" | "task" | "release" to each row by the database it came from; flatten a relation to the related rows' titles joined by ", "; every other property to a plain string as in fetch. Never build the list from the plan.
